edits.text: adaptation: 'Three combat waves precede the rescue. The 2D route and two interaction markers compress the nest, lifts, stairs and landing platform. Newt has no HP or damageable combat entity. Queen damage is nonlethal. Ripley Aliens uses her M41A, M240, hive cover and M41A grenade here with adapted combat ranges and effects; power-loader actions remain in other contexts. The separate Sulaco tactical reconstruction (50101) follows this rescue; source choreography and artwork remain partial.'

import { selectSourceSceneParticipants, createSourceSceneEncounter, executeSourceSceneCommand, advanceSourceScene, getSourceSceneState, getSourceSceneSummary, runSourceSceneAI } from './sourceSceneEncounter.js';
import { drawSourceSceneBoard } from './sourceScenePresentation.js';

// Source threats are environmental scene entities, not arbitrary enemy HP pools.
    if (this.sourceScene) return;

if (this.sourceScene?.definition.material === 'shuttle' && this.sourceScene.done.has('harness')
      && unit === this.sourceScene.actor && (c !== unit.gridX || r !== unit.gridY)) return false;

getSourceSceneState() { return getSourceSceneState(this); }

  triggerSourceSceneAction(id, turnToken) { return executeSourceSceneCommand(this, id, turnToken); }

const sourceField = getSourceSceneBattlefield(stage);
  if (sourceField) return sourceField;

Combat waves, the 2D route, interaction markers and carrier-loss condition adapt the film rescue; Newt is not a damageable combatant. The separate Sulaco tactical reconstruction (50101) follows this rescue; source choreography and artwork remain partial.',

adaptation: 'Les vagues et la route 2D condensent le sauvetage dans le processeur. Newt est un repère non ciblable. La défaite du porteur fait échouer l’évacuation. La mission tactique Sulaco (50101) poursuit séparément cette évacuation ; sa grille et sa chorégraphie restent adaptées.' },

adaptation: 'Waves and the 2D route condense the processor rescue. Newt is a non-targetable marker. Losing her carrier fails the evacuation. The separate Sulaco tactical mission (50101) follows this evacuation; its grid and choreography remain adapted.' }
